messages:
mia_cs: Quick sync — Kestrel Corp private deploy: final signoff needed on network egress policy and KMS rotation window before cutover tomorrow at 09:00 PT. I uploaded the revised runbook: https://wiki.redwood/kestrel/runbook (see section 4).

jordan_infra: Reviewing now. One question: are we comfortable with the 10.0.0.0/16 peering range? They requested smaller CIDR but infra said /16 to avoid overlapping when they scale.

leila_sec: From security side: KMS key policy looks okay but we need a defined rotation cadence in the contract. Current proposal is auto-rotate every 90 days with a 7-day pre-rotation alert to Kestrel ops. Does CS have flexibility to push that into SOW?

mia_cs: We can add the 90d rotation clause. Kestrel ops asked for a 180d default but will accept 90 if we document the exceptions process. I updated the SOW draft and linked it in the runbook.

jordan_infra: Network checklist:
```
- VPCs created in us-west-2 (kestrel-prod-vpc)
- Private subnets: 3 AZs
- NAT gateways: 1 per AZ
- Route tables: routes to on-prem via TGW attachment: tgw-0abc123
- Security groups: minimal egress, allow 443 to 10.5.0.0/16 for internal services
```
I still need firewall rules from Kestrel to confirm egress to our metrics/monitoring endpoints.

oliver_pm: @mia_cs please confirm if we should enable audit log shipping to their SIEM immediately or stage it after go-live? Customer compliance team prefers logs forwarded to their Splunk instance asap.

leila_sec: Recommend enabling audit logs to a temporary, read-only bucket with lifecycle 90d, then mirror to their Splunk via the connector. That reduces risk during early cutover. Also require that Kestrel's IAM role for cross-account access uses least privilege.

mia_cs: Agreed. I'll propose: temporary bucket (rw for redwood-svc, ro for kestrel-svc) + Splunk connector. Will add to runbook under "Audit log handoff".

jordan_infra: One blocker I found: Kestrel's on-prem firewall blocks outbound to our health-check endpoint on 10.240.5.12:443. We need their network team to open it or provide a proxy. I pinged their netops and copied the ticket: https://support.kestrel/INC-4521

leila_sec: Also confirm the KMS key import procedure. If they bring their own key (BYOK), we need the key material delivery window and confirmation steps documented.

mia_cs: Kestrel confirmed they will do BYOK. They can deliver material today but asked for a 2-hour maintenance window for import and test.

oliver_pm: Risk note for renewal: if cutover slips >7 days, sales asked to prep a discount clause offer. Can we surface that now in the playbook so CS/AE can act quickly?

mia_cs: Noted. I'll flag renewal-risk if cutover >7d and add AE escalation steps.

audit-bot: [audit] policy-check: Kestrel-KMS-policy.json passed (severity: low). Details: https://audit.redwood/policies/1998765432

jordan_infra: Ok next steps: 1) Kestrel netops to open 10.240.5.12:443 or provide proxy (INC-4521) 2) Mia to update SOW with 90d KMS rotation + exception process 3) Leila to provide final IAM role snippet for cross-account access 4) Enable temp audit bucket and configure Splunk connector post-import.

mia_cs: I'll owner 2 and 4. @leila_sec can you drop the IAM snippet in this thread?

leila_sec: Dropping minimal IAM snippet below — please review and confirm before we paste in runbook:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*","kms:DescribeKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" }
  ]
}
```
Note: keep key ARN scoped to the customer account and limit actions to only what the importer needs.

mia_cs: Perfect, thanks. I'll add that exact snippet to the runbook and notify Kestrel for final validation.

jordan_infra: I'll follow up with netops now and update INC-4521. If they confirm proxy within 2 hours we can still hit the 09:00 PT cutover.

oliver_pm: Thanks team — please ping me if any of the four blockers fail so we can loop in sales/leadership.

mia_cs: Will do. Closing loop here once netops responds. :thumbsup:
